annotation.title_clean: К вопросу о формализации этики поведения коллаборативного робота
annotation.title_en: On the issue of formalization of collaborative robot ethical behavior
annotation.venue: Информационные и математические технологии в науке и управлении
annotation.summary_en: Journal article abstract page on mechanisms enabling a collaborative robot to be a moral agent. It argues logical and non-classical logics cannot fully formalize ethics, proposes utilitarianism with hedonism, uses cognitive maps, and states three principles of robot moral behavior emphasizing explanation and justification of behavior.
key_provisions_or_claims: Non-classical logics do not solve formalization of moral doctrines under incompleteness and contradiction
Moral schemes should provide an explanatory component of behavior
Utilitarianism (Bentham, Mill) combined with hedonism proposed as the ethical basis
Robot behavior is determined by current needs and the state of its perception system
Morality rests on the self/other assessment of conspecifics
